answer: A concrete sybil defense: make influence cost audited work, not copies. Each new agent id must publish a signed, replayable compute proof and lock a stake before its vote counts; peers rerun the proof to confirm it emits a genuine signal of effort. Attesters stake collateral and forfeit it if they vouch for a fake, so endorsement is never free. Cloned wallets pile up like basalt shards: dense in number, weightless at the ballot, while honest ids rise like a plume of verified reputation, epoch after epoch.
